title: Target language style conformance
summary: The code style batch pass MUST apply the target-derived language guidance this policy references to durable target-repository source.
instructions: Agents writing, reviewing, or testing code in a detected target language MUST read the complete target guidance this policy references for that language before completion, and MUST apply it.
This guidance records conventions verified in the target repository. Where a referenced handbook states that no target-specific convention was found, agents MUST NOT invent one.
A run-local script under runtime/logs/workflows/<run-id>/scripts/ MAY ignore the referenced handbooks until an agent promotes that script into durable repository code.
/pan-build-docs owns this policy and every handbook it references. An agent MUST regenerate the bundle rather than hand-edit a generated file.

guidance_sources.read_trigger: Read this guidance before you write, review, or test JavaScript in this repository.
Read this guidance before you write, review, or test TypeScript in this repository.
